purpose: Protocol-corrected real-papyrus deletion-control calibration for issue #151. V1 is preserved as FAIL because its 41x41 maximum deletion consumed its entire 41x41 evaluation window. V2 changes only the evaluation-window geometry needed to make the pre-existing outside-stability statistic measurable.
claim_boundary: A positive result establishes omission sensitivity only for w035 material that the independent surface-m7 source already supports near the known reference surface. It does not establish complete discovery of unknown papyrus outside an arbitrary inventory, physical recto identity, or Grand Prize eligibility.

deletion_protocol.rectangle_rule: For odd size S and frozen center [y,x], delete valid TIFXYZ vertices with |dy|<=floor(S/2) and |dx|<=floor(S/2). Invalid vertices remain invalid and do not count toward deletion denominator.
deletion_protocol.center_selection: Six already-frozen geometry-only sheetness probes, selected before any coverage-witness response is read. No prediction density, CT intensity, ink, or deletion outcome may replace a center. V2 does not alter or replace any center after observing V1.
deletion_protocol.missing_patch_policy: A patch with too few valid or independently supported witness points remains in the denominator and may fail the experiment; do not substitute another center.
deletion_protocol.evaluation_window_rule: Evaluate witnesses in a frozen 51x51 material-grid window centered on each unchanged deletion center. Deletions remain 21x21, 31x31, and 41x41. The 51x51 window leaves a five-material-vertex annulus around the largest deletion on every side.

witness_association.normal_method: Same centered TIFXYZ tangent cross-product convention used by scroliq-sheetness-plan.
witness_association.candidate_rule: At each valid patch vertex with a valid centered normal, sample the frozen surface-m7 prediction and masked CT at the five signed normal offsets. A witness exists when prediction > 127 and CT > 0. Choose the smallest absolute offset; negative wins exact ties.
witness_association.baseline_association_note: This stage deliberately calibrates omission sensitivity only where the independent source co-locates with known w035 material. It is not a global witness-discovery test.

counterfactuals.omission: Remove the frozen material-grid patch from the reference surface.

parallel_substitution.rule: Replace each deleted valid vertex having a valid normal by the same 3-D point shifted +20 voxels along that frozen local normal. This is a synthetic parallel-sheet falsifier, not a claim about an actual neighboring winding.

metric.method: nearest 3-D Euclidean distance from each independently supported witness point to the counterfactual submitted-surface point cloud

denominators.deletion_recall: all independently supported witnesses whose source TIFXYZ material index lies inside the frozen deletion rectangle
denominators.outside_stability: all independently supported witnesses in the frozen 51x51 evaluation window but outside the active deletion rectangle

decision_rule.interpretation: Passing is necessary but not sufficient for promotion. V2 corrects only the v1 evaluation-window geometry; all witness-source, deletion, association, tolerance, and threshold choices are unchanged. A positive result unlocks a separately preregistered Stage B: extract witnesses without conditioning on the known surface and measure false unexplained clusters on intact real papyrus.

reproducibility.response_selection: No center, deletion size, threshold, tolerance, witness-source parameter, decision threshold, or 51x51 evaluation-window size may change after this spec is merged.

predecessor.failure_reason: The 41x41 deletion equaled the 41x41 evaluation window, leaving zero outside witnesses and therefore undefined outside_stability.
